summary: Assuming RH, the asymptotic proportion of distinct critical-line zeros is at least 85.6103644552% in both dyadic (T, 2T] and cumulative (0, T] windows, with the denominator counting multiplicity. We combine Yuanda Xu’s weighted simple-zero estimate with our joint certificate.
method: Xu’s weighted simple-zero method and a joint rational certificate for distinct zeros
model: Astra 6.2, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Fable 5.2, Gemini Neon and Carbon
